question: Should OpenClaw accept a node-to-model tool advertisement contract, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431 be the canonical implementation path after compatibility and security-boundary repair?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix; it changes which connected-node capabilities become model-visible executable tools, so automation cannot choose the permanent product and trust boundary.

options.title: Use the open PR as candidate path
options.body: Resolve the remaining compatibility/security questions in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431, then land it if the node-hosted tool trust model is accepted.

options.title: Keep wrapper plugins for now
options.body: Reject direct node-advertised tools for now and keep plugin or MCP wrappers as the supported extension path until a safer contract is designed.

options.title: Narrow to an SDK helper first
options.body: Defer node-advertised tools and add a smaller plugin SDK or Gateway invocation helper to remove the HTTP token loopback workaround.

recommendation.title: Use the open PR as candidate path
recommendation.body: Resolve the remaining compatibility/security questions in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90431, then land it if the node-hosted tool trust model is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the open candidate PR and has the strongest current history on the Gateway/node/tool boundary.
